$comment: Single source of truth for the workflow graph. state.js init copies the selected subgraph into runs/<id>/events.jsonl (plan event); hooks and state.js read dependencies from there, never from prose.

requirements-formalizer.summary: Turns the confirmed user input into a normalized requirements document (goal, baseline, constraints, success criteria).

knowledge-assessor.summary: Compares current knowledge with the goal, produces the gap analysis, prerequisite order and the module list.

resource-researcher.summary: Researches learning resources per module with web search and verifies every URL through the fetch MCP server.

practice-designer.summary: Designs hands-on exercises and projects for every module.

assessment-designer.select_when: The learner wants checkpoints, quizzes, self-assessments or targets a certification.
assessment-designer.summary: Designs checkpoints, quizzes and rubrics per milestone.

schedule-planner.summary: Fits modules, resources, exercises and checkpoints into the weekly time budget and deadline.

validator.summary: Quality gate: checks every planner artifact against the requirements and emits a machine-readable verdict.

path-synthesizer.summary: Combines all validated artifacts into the final learning path document with a fixed section skeleton.

html-builder.summary: Renders the approved learning path as HTML from the fixed template and copies the Markdown to output/.
